document.name: ListGridFixture
document.documentation:
Non-persistent Kitchen Sink fixture for the PrimeFaces list grid renderers.
Its view lists the lookup values twice: once in a Vue list grid and once in a PrimeFaces data table, chosen by each list grid's componentBuilderClass property. Each grid has a selectedIdBinding, so a row can be selected as well as zoomed into. A data grid of rows has one too, for dataGridSelect.

id.name: selectedVueId
id.description: The bizId of the row selected in the Vue list grid.

id.name: selectedFacesId
id.description: The bizId of the row selected in the PrimeFaces data table.

id.name: selectedRowId
id.description: The bizId of the row selected in the data grid of rows.

collection.name: rows
collection.description: Lookup values added to the data grid that a row can be selected in (dataGridSelect).
